widgets.label: Safe Mode toggle
widgets.description: Persistent control that pauses animation, stops marquees, mutes audio, and raises contrast. Provided by the safety layer and required on every build.

widgets.label: Text-only version link
widgets.description: A plain link to a stripped, high-contrast version of the page. Period-correct and the main accessibility escape hatch.

widgets.label: Last updated stamp
widgets.description: A hand-typed or Timestamp-component date such as Last updated 3/14/98.

widgets.label: Plain mailto footer
widgets.description: An address element or webmaster line with a mailto link.

widgets.label: Email me graphic
widgets.description: An animated or static Email Me graphic wrapped in a mailto link.

widgets.label: Best viewed badge
widgets.description: Best viewed with a named browser at a named resolution. Use generic text or an original badge for client work.

widgets.label: Visible hit counter
widgets.description: Odometer digits such as You are visitor #004217.

widgets.label: Guestbook
widgets.description: Sign my guestbook page with dated visitor entries. Replaces testimonials.

widgets.label: Webring box
widgets.description: Bordered table with previous, next, random, and list links for a themed ring.

widgets.label: Under construction sign
widgets.description: Construction sign on unfinished sections. On FrontPage sites usually a single small GIF on a stub page.

widgets.label: Rainbow horizontal rule
widgets.description: A GIF divider used in place of the hr element.

widgets.label: Starry tiled background
widgets.description: Black, dark blue, or purple tile scattered with stars.

widgets.label: Neighborhood address
widgets.description: A themed homestead address such as SiliconValley/Heights/4021 matching the site topic.

widgets.label: What's New log
widgets.description: Dated update log with NEW graphics. On corporate sites it becomes Press Releases or News.

widgets.label: Click-to-play background music
widgets.description: A Turn on music control that plays a pre-rendered MIDI-style track only after a click.

widgets.label: Splash or Enter page
widgets.description: Logo plus an ENTER link before the real home page.

widgets.label: Cursor trail
widgets.description: DHTML sparkle or dot trail following the pointer. Disabled in Safe Mode.

widgets.label: Instant messenger handle
widgets.description: ICQ number or AIM screen name in place of chat or social links.

widgets.label: 88x31 button wall
widgets.description: A cluster of 88 by 31 pixel link buttons for friends, tools, and causes.

widgets.label: Status bar or text box scroller
widgets.description: Scrolling message, faked in a form text field or a styled status strip because browsers ignore window.status.

widgets.label: Shared borders
widgets.description: FrontPage-style top, left, and bottom regions repeated on every page.

widgets.label: Theme page banner
widgets.description: A themed banner graphic carrying the page title, generated per page.

widgets.label: Hover button navigation
widgets.description: Beveled nav buttons with a hover state, rebuilt as image swaps the way careful developers did after Java applets failed.

widgets.label: Search this site form
widgets.description: A small search form, FreeFind style on personal pages or the Search component on corporate pages.

widgets.label: Feedback form
widgets.description: Contact Us form with name, email, comments, and a gray Submit button.

widgets.label: Corporate copyright footer
widgets.description: Copyright, company, All rights reserved, and a Webmaster mailto.

widgets.label: Printer-friendly link
widgets.description: Printer-friendly version link, the period answer to alternate color schemes.

widgets.label: Broken component placeholder
widgets.description: A bracketed placeholder such as [Hit Counter] shown when a host lacked server extensions. A lived-in detail.

widgets.label: Frames or browser notice
widgets.description: This site uses frames or requires a newer browser notice, the period equivalent of a cookie banner.

widgets.label: Rotating banner ad
widgets.description: 468 by 60 rotating banner, originally a Java applet, rebuilt as an image swap.

widgets.label: Flash-style intro
widgets.description: Fixed 550 by 400 stage with an animated intro and Skip Intro link, rebuilt in HTML and CSS.

widgets.label: Portal modules
widgets.description: Weather, stocks, headlines, and My Page style boxes in a three-column table.

widgets.label: User CSS layout
widgets.description: A pasted style block that restyles the default profile tables. The layering is the point.

widgets.label: Profile blurbs
widgets.description: About Me and Who I'd Like to Meet sections.

widgets.label: Interests and Details tables
widgets.description: Interests rows and a Details table with status, hometown, and similar fields.

widgets.label: Contact table
widgets.description: Send Message, Add to Friends, Instant Message, and similar actions in a grid.

widgets.label: Top 8 friends
widgets.description: Grid of eight friend avatars with names. Replaces customer logo strips.

widgets.label: Comments wall
widgets.description: Friend comments with avatars, timestamps, and graphics such as Thanks for the add.

widgets.label: Profile song player
widgets.description: Small player box for the profile song, click to play only.

widgets.label: Glitter text
widgets.description: Sparkling animated text graphic for the display name or headings.

widgets.label: Blinkies
widgets.description: Small 150 by 20 animated text strips that declare likes and moods.

widgets.label: Online Now indicator
widgets.description: Small Online Now graphic next to the profile photo.

widgets.label: Profile views count
widgets.description: Profile Views count in plain text, the profile era replacement for the hit counter.

widgets.label: Custom cursor
widgets.description: Custom cursor image set through user CSS.
